payments.body: Cash on delivery works from day one. You can take InstaPay and wallet transfers, or connect your Paymob or Kashier account to accept cards.

pricing.title: Two simple plans. Switch any time.
pricing.body: Start free and pay a few cents per order, or go Pro for a flat monthly price.

how.title: Three steps from idea to first order
how.s1Body: Pick your store link, add your email and a password, or continue with Google. That's all signup asks for.
how.s2Body: Choose a template, add your logo, colors and products, and arrange sections with the visual editor.
how.s3Body: Publish with one click, share your link, and top up your wallet from $5 to follow your orders in the dashboard.

faq.title: Questions before you start
faq.desc: Can't find your answer? <link>Message us on WhatsApp.</link>

items.q: What does an order cost on the free plan?
items.a: $0.03 per created order, whatever its value. No monthly fee and no percentage. You'll need a first $5 top-up before you can see orders and send campaigns.
From about 1,000 orders a month, the flat $29 costs less than per-order fees. Pro also gives you 2,000 AI credits.
Each AI action, like preparing a product from photos or text, uses one credit. Credits are shared across your whole account, not per team member.

items.q: Can I manage my store from ChatGPT or Claude?
items.a: Yes, for products today. Connect your Tallaby account once, then ask the assistant to add, edit, publish or hide products.

items.q: Can I use my own domain?
items.a: Your store starts on yourbrand.tallaby.com. Connect a domain you own from Website › Domain.

items.q: Do I need to know how to code?
items.a: No. Design, products, payments and shipping are all set up from your dashboard.
